cover_headline: India's 300th T20I Brings a First: 200 Outright Wins in the Format

end.headline: India's 300th T20I Brings a First: 200 Outright Wins in the Format
end.line: Saturday's four-wicket win over New Zealand in Christchurch was India's 300th men's T20I and their 200th outright win.

facts: India played their 300th men's T20 international in Christchurch, becoming only the second team after Pakistan (304) to reach the mark
The four-wicket win over New Zealand was India's 200th outright T20I win — the first team to reach that figure
Tilak Varma's unbeaten 51 off 26 balls and his unbroken 69-run stand with Nitish Kumar Reddy closed the chase with a ball to spare
